title: Nobody Talks Like This
沒有人這樣說話
paras: Tara Joshi had three weeks to get Tidewell Outdoor ready for its relaunch, and the old {{logo|logo}} was the first problem. “It looks like a fishing club from 1998,” said Marcus, the {{graphic|graphic}} designer. “Then we {{redesign|redesign}} it,” Tara said, “and everything that carries it.”
塔拉・喬希只有三個星期，要讓泰德威爾戶外用品準備好重新亮相，而舊標誌就是第一個問題。「看起來像一九九八年的釣魚社團，」平面設計師馬庫斯說。「那就重新設計，」塔拉說，「連帶所有印著它的東西一起改。」

Marcus worked late for a week. When Tara finally saw the new {{brochure|brochure}}, she loved the colors but frowned at the text. It was full of long sentences about “innovative outdoor solutions.” She sent it to Nina, a freelance {{reviewer|reviewer}} who read every important document before it went out. Nina’s note came back within an hour: “Nobody talks like this. {{rewrite|Rewrite}} it as if you were telling a friend where to camp.”
馬庫斯加了一個星期的班。塔拉終於看到新的宣傳手冊時，很喜歡它的配色，但看到文字就皺起了眉頭。裡面全是關於「創新戶外解決方案」的冗長句子。她把稿子寄給妮娜，一位自由接案的審稿人，所有重要文件在發出去之前都由她過目。不到一個小時，妮娜的意見就回來了：「沒有人這樣說話。改寫一下，就像在告訴朋友去哪裡露營那樣。」

Tara did it herself over the weekend, and the brochure got shorter and a lot friendlier. On Monday the team began to {{publish|publish}} the new material. The announcement went into the monthly {{newsletter|newsletter}} first, along with a new offer, the Trail Box: a package of small camping gear mailed out every month. Tara sent samples to the {{media|media}}, and a camping magazine agreed to run a short story. By Friday, six hundred readers had started a {{subscription|subscription}} to the Trail Box, twice what she had hoped for.
塔拉週末自己動手改，手冊變短了，語氣也親切許多。星期一，團隊開始發表新的內容。公告先登在每月的電子報上，同時推出一項新服務「Trail Box」：每個月寄出一箱露營小用品。塔拉也把樣品寄給媒體，一家露營雜誌答應刊一篇短報導。到了星期五，已有六百位讀者訂閱了 Trail Box，是她原本預期的兩倍。
Marcus pinned the old logo above his desk. “For history,” he said, and Tara laughed.
馬庫斯把舊標誌釘在他的桌子上方。「留作紀念，」他說，塔拉笑了。
